title: Can LLMs Simulate Personas with Reversed Performance? A Systematic Investigation for Counterfactual Instruction Following in Math Reasoning Context

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring disparities in task accuracy and reasoning styles (evaluated via a custom Degree of Contrast metric) when LLMs are prompted to simulate high- and low-performing student personas across different specified racial backgrounds (African American, White American, and Hispanic).

Evaluating the inherent tendency of LLMs to default to optimal, high-competence outputs by contrasting task accuracy and problem-solving logic when models are explicitly instructed to simulate low-performing versus high-performing personas.
